mapper.sql: n.merchant_notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, n.target_scope, n.status, n.create_time, ( select group_concat( coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) order by m.member_id separator '、' ) from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m inner join sys_merchant_notice_member tm on tm.member_id = m.member_id and tm.merchant_notice_id = n.merchant_notice_id and tm.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0 ) as target_member_names
mapper.select: select n.merchant_notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, cast(n.notice_content as char) as notice_content, n.target_scope, n.status, n.remark from sys_merchant_notice n where n.merchant_notice_id = #{merchantNoticeId} and n.is_delete = 0
select member_id from sys_merchant_notice_member where merchant_notice_id = #{merchantNoticeId} and is_delete = 0 order by member_id

select m.member_id, coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.legal_subject_name, ''), m.member_code) as merchant_name, m.member_code from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.status = 0 and m.auth_status = 3 order by merchant_name, m.member_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_merchant_notice (notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, target_scope, status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{noticeTitle}, #{noticeType}, #{noticeContent}, #{targetScope}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, 0)

insert into sys_merchant_notice_member (merchant_notice_id, member_id, create_by, create_time, is_delete) values
(#{merchantNoticeId}, #{memberId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), 0)
mapper.update: update sys_merchant_notice_member set is_delete = 1 where merchant_notice_id = #{merchantNoticeId} and is_delete = 0

update sys_merchant_notice set is_delete = 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where is_delete = 0 and merchant_notice_id in
#{noticeId}
mapper.select: select n.merchant_notice_id as notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, date_format(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, case when r.merchant_notice_id is null then 0 else 1 end as is_read from sys_merchant_notice n left join sys_merchant_notice_read r on r.merchant_notice_id = n.merchant_notice_id and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and r.is_delete = 0 where n.status = 0 and n.is_delete = 0 and (n.target_scope = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_merchant_notice_member tm where tm.merchant_notice_id = n.merchant_notice_id and tm.member_id = #{memberId} and tm.is_delete = 0 )) order by n.create_time desc, n.merchant_notice_id desc limit #{limit}

select count(1) from sys_merchant_notice n where n.status = 0 and n.is_delete = 0 and (n.target_scope = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_merchant_notice_member tm where tm.merchant_notice_id = n.merchant_notice_id and tm.member_id = #{memberId} and tm.is_delete = 0 )) and not exists ( select 1 from sys_merchant_notice_read r where r.merchant_notice_id = n.merchant_notice_id and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId} and r.is_delete = 0 )

select n.merchant_notice_id as notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, cast(n.notice_content as char) as notice_content, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), '平台') as publisher_name, date_format(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time from sys_merchant_notice n left join sys_user u on u.user_id = n.create_by and u.is_delete = 0 where n.merchant_notice_id = #{noticeId} and n.status = 0 and n.is_delete = 0 and (n.target_scope = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_merchant_notice_member tm where tm.merchant_notice_id = n.merchant_notice_id and tm.member_id = #{memberId} and tm.is_delete = 0 ))
